measurement.throughput: verified request/echo round trips per second
measurement.latency: client fetch start through complete response body
measurement.table_summary: median of the five sample values
measurement.payload_mib: request and response body bytes combined

build.linux: CMake/Ninja Release; HTTP/2 uses the Release nghttp2 archive and QUIC uses Release ngtcp2/OpenSSL archives.
build.windows: Native Windows COFF objects and libraries cross-compiled from the same dependency sources; all application and foundation modules use -O3 -DNDEBUG; module source, object, and BMI generated in one compiler invocation.

provenance.retained_samples: Unchanged epoll HTTP/1 samples were reused. Epoll HTTP/2 samples were replaced after correcting Release archive discovery. HTTP/3 samples follow the pacing and completed-stream lifetime fixes. Windows samples and checks were replaced after applying uniform Release optimization to foundation modules.

limitations: No macOS/BSD runtime host was available; kqueue is unmeasured.
HTTP/1 and HTTP/2 use cleartext TCP; HTTP/3 uses TLS 1.3.
Windows IORing uses the shared IOCP socket path for TCP and UDP.
The workload measures one in-flight exchange, not concurrent service capacity.

items.problem: On-loop cancellation could leave an already-visited native request pending before a blocking wait.
items.change: Rescan the native active queue before blocking.

items.problem: Two-step Windows BMI-to-object validation compilation omitted exception copy-function metadata.
items.change: Compile each module source, object, and BMI together.

items.problem: Queued receive completions could observe QUIC closing state; early socket release exposed late peer packets to ICMP.
items.change: Handle ERR_CLOSING and retain the UDP socket through connection/stream owner teardown.

items.problem: A later control-only write probe could clear a pacing deadline after an earlier stream-data probe was blocked.
items.change: Use one timestamp for all write candidates in a pass.

items.problem: Completed HTTP/3 streams retained nghttp3 records and server transport handles, causing growing scans and memory use during sustained sampling.
items.change: Close the nghttp3 stream after inbound completion and local FIN acknowledgement; release completed handles while retaining connection streams.
items.interrupted_sample: The pre-fix epoll HTTP/3 sample was terminated after 129 seconds at approximately 664 MiB RSS and is excluded.

items.problem: The local NGHTTP2_LIBRARY_RELEASE cache selected the Debug archive.
items.change: Locate vcpkg Release and Debug archives in their respective directories, clear the incorrect cache entry, and replace affected HTTP/2 samples.

items.problem: The Windows measurement helper initially compiled foundation modules without Release optimization.
items.change: Compile all foundation modules with -O3 -DNDEBUG; replace all affected Windows checks and performance samples.
